plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: brand seal, then bottle, then a generous headline/subhead block, then a properly sized CTA with breathing room from the right edge, fixing the engine's dead left zone and jammed button.
Product-led strip: the bottle anchors the left edge, the copy follows, and the CTA sits beside the Quillbrook seal as a brand sign-off cluster on the right.
Message-first reading order: small brand seal then the headline lead off on the left, the bottle sits as the visual pivot between the message and the action, and the CTA closes on the right.
